question: Where’s the closest hotel positioned on the way to Mount Hope Estate, Manheim, PA from Charlotte's Quest Nature Center, Manchester, MD?
sql: SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_state, pois.addr_city FROM pois WHERE pois.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Charlotte''s Quest Nature Center%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mount Hope Estate%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 5000 -- 5 km buffer around the straight line path ) ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Charlotte''s Quest Nature Center%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
